archaic.definition: Archaic means belonging to an earlier period of time and no longer in everyday use.
archaic.task: Write one sentence of your own using the word archaic. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know archaic should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Much of his vocabulary felt archaic, so tied to his own century that Priya sometimes had to guess at his meaning.

Ancient means extremely old — often thousands of years old — and speaks only to age. Archaic is about use, not age alone: an archaic word or custom belongs to an earlier era and has dropped out of current practice. A mountain is ancient, but it cannot be archaic, because it was never something people used.

Obsolete means discarded because something newer replaced it, like floppy disks. Archaic points to an earlier era of history rather than to replacement by an upgrade: archaic laws or spellings belong to a vanished period. A gadget from last decade can be obsolete without being archaic — nothing about it belongs to a distant age.

Antiquated is a disapproving word for what is old-fashioned and no longer works well, like an antiquated filing system that slows an office down. Archaic is more neutral and scholarly: it places a thing in a vanished historical era without complaining about it. Scholars prize archaic manuscripts; no one prizes an antiquated system.

ancestral.definition: Ancestral means inherited from, or belonging to, one's ancestors.
ancestral.task: Write one sentence of your own using the word ancestral. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know ancestral should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The family still gathers every summer at the ancestral farmhouse where five generations before them were raised.
A new backpack is simply recent; new says nothing about where a thing came from, while ancestral carries a whole family line — generations of hands passing something forward.
Calling it a family recipe could mean your mother invented it last year; ancestral is stronger, insisting the recipe has traveled down through distant generations.
You can inherit a watch from an uncle who bought it new last month; inherited only means passed to you, while ancestral reaches further back, binding a thing to a long chain of forebears.

Hereditary describes traits or conditions passed on through genes, like eye color or some diseases. Ancestral is broader and less biological: ancestral things — lands, homes, customs — come down from your forebears without traveling in your DNA. If genetics is the channel, the word is hereditary, not ancestral.

Ancestral adds depth in time: it insists the thing descends from forebears generations back. Your familial bonds are with living relatives; your ancestral estate comes from the long dead.

Traditional describes customs or practices honored because a community has long repeated them. Ancestral is narrower and more personal: it ties a thing to your own family's forebears. A town festival can be traditional without belonging to anyone's ancestors, but ancestral land belongs to one family's line.

ancillary.definition: Ancillary means serving a supporting or secondary role rather than a central one.
ancillary.task: Write one sentence of your own using the word ancillary. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know ancillary should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The main lecture ran ninety minutes, but the professor treated the slides as ancillary, useful only if a student happened to miss a word.
Something incidental is barely connected and could vanish without anyone noticing, while ancillary work genuinely supports the main effort.
Supplementary material only adds an optional extra on top of something already complete, while ancillary support actively helps the central work run.

Auxiliary describes backup help held in reserve, ready to step in when needed — an auxiliary generator waits for the main power to fail. Ancillary support is different: it works alongside the main effort all the time, not only when something goes wrong.

Subsidiary means lower in rank and controlled by something above it, the way a subsidiary company answers to its parent firm. Ancillary stresses the helping role itself, while subsidiary stresses the chain of ownership and command that runs downward.

An accessory part is a detachable extra added onto something finished, like an accessory lens clipped to a camera. Ancillary work is more built-in than that: it exists to serve the main task and runs alongside it rather than being snapped on afterward.
Names the main, essential thing that everything else revolves around and supports — the exact opposite of a secondary, supporting role.

chronology.definition: Chronology means the order in which events actually happened in time, or an account that sets events out in that order.

pinnacle.definition: Pinnacle means the highest point of success or achievement.

stratification.definition: Stratification means the arrangement of people or things into distinct, ranked layers or levels.
